_source: AI-researched NEW DISTRICT candidates for Manchester and Cheshire, awaiting review — never directly promoted by the research agent. Populated by the same daily scheduled research agent as venue-suggestions.json (2026-08, at explicit user request), committed straight to master the same way (see that file's own doc comment for why). Expected to be rare: the research brief (.claude/agents/curia-research-daily.md) treats district suggestions as an occasional finding (a genuinely distinct, not-yet-covered high-end area within Manchester or Cheshire), not a daily quota — most days should add zero entries here. The daily curia-suggestion-review agent (.claude/agents/curia-suggestion-review.md) is the only thing that promotes an entry into the real docs/data/districts.json, behind its own pull request. Each entry mirrors docs/data/districts.json's own raw shape (name/metro/lat/lon/base/kind/accentColor/editorialDescription) so an approved entry can be copied straight in, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) stripped on promotion. `metro` must be 'manchester' or 'cheshire' only — never 'los-angeles' or a new metro (out of scope, per the user's explicit 'shouldn't go beyond cheshire and manchester just yet').
_reviewWorkflow: Same as venue-suggestions.json: status starts 'pending', the review agent flips it to 'approved' (then copies fields into districts.json, as part of its own PR) or 'rejected' (kept here with researchNotes so it isn't re-suggested). A human's real review happens by reading/merging that PR.
